scope: Explicit finite study v4 and matching assessment v4 reuse existing original-request capacity policy. Supplied workers, API replies and native outcomes; real trusted controllers, temporary filesystem/SQLite accounting. No actual original P/C execution, provider call or live allocation.

implementation.policies: Both exact existing feedback-comparison policy and closed proposal-capacity policy are mandatory in study v4. Only v4/v4 pairing is accepted.
implementation.legacy: Study/assessment v1/v2/v3 keep original schema shapes, funding meaning, helper inventories and witness keyword omission. No old record is upgraded.
implementation.pre_owner: Active v4 configuration checks supported model context and proposal output allowance before a new owner or worker. Unsupported configuration has a typed static diagnostic.
implementation.all_original_calls: Counted proposals, common starting-agent mutation witnesses and child mutation witnesses reuse settled original requests, raw replies, inclusive usage, charges and existing checkpoint reconstruction. Planning calls are included; no second API copy is sent.
implementation.ordering: Passing original checkpoint required before private child source copy, screen/generation, downstream witness or terminal decision. Complete original proposal precedes future artifacts. Exact checkpoint-path census refuses foreign/orphan/future records.
implementation.partial: Negative or unavailable full replacement evidence stops the whole study as proposal_capacity partial with exact stage, child:null, complete planned denominators, costs and unresolved holds. require_replacement:true also applies to rejected, malformed, unobserved and callback-free proposals; they are not silently completed rejected opportunities.
implementation.interruption: Original completed replies are reused after interruption without another proposal send. Capacity-failure observations rederive an actual negative original checkpoint. Genuine cancellation/resource stops may precede checkpoint publication.
implementation.assessment: Existing full development inspection carries v4 capacity verification into finalist freeze and final execution; no second assessment-specific mechanism.

Two new methods reproduced four failures: premature decision before original proposal; witness and decision artifacts hidden behind a negative checkpoint; masked capacity-specific preowner cause. Local v4 guards/typed diagnostic corrected. No demonstrated source execution or paid-spending bypass.
Valid assessment v4 schema failed before implementation. First later positive fixture was refused by the existing mismatched-profile guard; fixture setup was corrected.

corrected_final_three_study_methods.checks: New artifact/partial-stage guards; valid unsupported preowner configuration; before/after checkpoint interruption with no new original proposal send and private-copy refusal.

assessment_contract.checks: Valid explicit4/4; strict pairing across all16version combinations; positive bounded aggregate final caps.

development_to_final_composition.qualification: One original fixture with five capacity checkpoints and six sealed cells. Checkpoint corruption after freeze refuses before final owner/send; restored original completes final assessment/analysis and keyless verification. Exact observed counts/costs/runtime retained in acceptance and captured original metadata.

passing_checks.test_cut_limits: The initial six methods and corrected three are separately recorded source cuts, not a final full-class/full-suite run. Hosted exact-head Linux/Windows suite remains required. Discovery is1890methods, not1890passing results.

preservation.old_evidence_method: Compare raw file hashes only; no SQL queries against original paid evidence.
preservation.delivery_guard: After this file is written, check-imp01-capacity-delivery-v1.py verifies source/evidence pins, raw historical PLAN rows, links,451old files and reserved final prompt literal absence. Its separate local receipt seals this public JSON without a self-reference cycle.
preservation.no_reserved_task_text_in_public_changes: Literal absence check only; not a universal covert-channel proof.

live_and_scientific_limits.next: Bind actual original P/C configuration, full-grid resources/runtime/fairness, statistical rule and target-repair/human-review arrangements before a separate reviewed live allocation. WildChat remains selected; Curated stays qualified historical/development evidence without another run.
live_and_scientific_limits.actual_model_capacity: Supplied replies and accounting establish software behavior only, not future original P/C request capacity, attention, semantic compliance or useful diversity.
live_and_scientific_limits.scientific_gates: IMP-01 and EVAL-02 remain open. Official scores stay authoritative; no historical rescore or benchmark change.
